title: Distilling Diffusion Score Discrepancy for Efficient Training Data Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2609.38776v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training data attribution for diffusion models aims to identify the training samples that influence a generated instance, but existing methods either require costly per-sample gradient computation or query-specific model optimization. Moreover, most methods attribute changes in a proxy loss rather than changes in the actual model's generative behavior. We address these limitations by formulating attribution directly with a local score discrepancy measure, which applies to any diffusion variant (including DDPM, EDM, and flow matching), and by showing that such measure can be estimated without retraining, as a preconditioned gradient similarity. We instantiate this estimator as Training-data Influence via score Discrepancy (TID), which uses Kronecker-factored curvature to avoid random projections and per-sample gradient storage. translated_title: 蒸馏扩散分数差异以实现高效的训练数据归因
translated_abstract: 扩散模型的训练数据归因旨在识别影响某个生成实例的训练样本，但现有方法要么需要代价高昂的逐样本梯度计算，要么需要针对特定查询的模型优化。此外，大多数方法归因的是代理损失的变化，而非模型实际生成行为的变化。我们通过直接采用局部分数差异度量来形式化归因，从而解决这些局限，该度量适用于任何扩散变体（包括 DDPM、EDM 和流匹配），并且我们证明该度量可以作为预条件化梯度相似度在无需重新训练的情况下进行估计。我们将此估计器实例化为基于分数差异的训练数据影响力方法 TID，它利用 Kronecker 分解曲率来避免随机投影和逐样本梯度存储。随后，我们将 TID 蒸馏为 TIDE，一个仅前向传播的在线训练学生模型，用于复现教师模型的排序……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于扩散分数差异、无需重新训练与逐样本梯度存储的归因方法 TID，并将其蒸馏为仅前向传播的在线学生模型 TIDE，从而实现对扩散模型生成结果的高效训练数据归因。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TID, a retraining-free training data attribution method for diffusion models based on local score discrepancy, and distills it into TIDE, a forward-only student model trained online, enabling efficient and scalable attribution of generated outputs to their influential training samples.
